o.norm: https://github.com/jhy/jsoup/issues/1556 escape in HTML for legibility; remove from xml

i.norm: Tests that ASCII control characters (below U+0020, excluding tab/LF/CR) are handled correctly when parsing HTML vs XML: - HTML keeps them escaped as hex entities (e.g.  and ) for legibility. - XML drops them entirely, because they are not valid XML 1.0 characters. See https://github.com/jhy/jsoup/issues/1556
ESC (U+001B) and BEL (U+0007) encoded as HTML hex entities
Input contains ESC and BEL in both an attribute value and in text content
HTML parser: control characters are preserved as hex-escaped entities
XML parser: control characters below U+0020 (except tab/LF/CR) are invalid in XML 1.0 and are silently dropped, leaving only the surrounding text
